limitations: Selected main Results, Figures 1 and 4-6 legends and the displayed main Experimental procedures were read in PMC HTML. Supplemental DOCX, movies, raw data and complete vessel-level analysis were not read. Null pericyte responses are bounded by this marker/geometry, stimulus, acquisition and temporal window; the paper does not establish zero contractile ability in all pericytes or resolve every Hall preparation difference.

Negative responses are finite-resolution/time-window findings, not proof of a universal zero. The reporter also labels non-mural populations, addressed partly by sparse-induction controls whose full supplement was not independently read.
